claims.evidence: Witness report shows “EOS 5D” and “Mark II” text visible on the body (Photo 2). No “Mark III” marking is shown.
No batteries are shown in the provided photos; only the camera body is visible.
No charger is shown in the provided photos.
No Godox trigger is shown in the provided photos.
Seller’s condition statement is incomplete in the message; no clear condition details are provided.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (Mark II vs Mark III). This affects value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the top plate/model label showing “5D Mark III” (or a menu/about screen showing the exact model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as Canon EOS 5D Mark II (worst-case vs the seller’s claim).

risks.risk: No lens shown—could be body-only, or lens may be missing/low quality.
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens attached (front + mount area) and lens model/serial label if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only (no lens).

risks.risk: Unknown physical condition (scratches, dents, cracked screen/ports).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: rear LCD (screen on/off), all ports (USB/HDMI), hot shoe, buttons/dials, and corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear and unverified port/switch condition.

risks.risk: Functionality not tested (shutter count, autofocus accuracy, button/dial responsiveness).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing: autofocus on a moving subject, menu navigation, and a short playback/recording test (if video is supported). Also show shutter count screen if available.

risks.risk: Sensor cleanliness/dust or scratches (not visible from the current angles).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the sensor at maximum magnification (or a test shot of a blank wall/sky showing dust spots).

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (2 batteries, charger, Godox trigger).
risks.proof: Photos of all items laid out: both batteries (with labels), charger, and the Godox mini trigger.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera body only with no accessories.

risks.risk: Battery health/charging readiness unknown (could hold poor charge).
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing battery indicator during operation and a test run (shooting short burst).

proof_requests: Clear photo showing the exact camera model: “Canon EOS 5D Mark III” (or an on-screen “About”/model screen).
Photo showing whether a lens is included: lens attached + lens model/label.
Close-up photos of rear LCD (on and off), hot shoe, ports, buttons/dials, and all corners/edges.
Short video test: autofocus on a moving subject + menu/button/dial responsiveness + quick playback/recording check.
Sensor cleanliness proof: test shot of a plain wall/sky (or sensor inspection photo).
Photos of all accessories claimed: 2 batteries, charger, and the Godox mini trigger.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, but the seller’s accessory/model claims are not shown. A worst-case price can be set for a used Mark II body with no lens/accessories until the missing proof is provided.
